record_type: supplemental observational summary; raw per-request inputs and generated clips are not included
scope: One 8x B200 SXM node, vllm/vllm-omni:cosmos3, nvidia/Cosmos3-Super snapshot e0262be9, 1280x720/189f/24fps
outcome: The recommended layout served successfully on B200; the runtime reported ulysses=4 and ring=1.

recommended_vs_tp8_guardrails_off.note: The recommended layout was about 9% faster on H200 and 10.7% to 12.5% faster in these B200 comparisons. Other GPU generations were not tested.

per_step_decomposition.note: Removing the approximately 3-second encode portion leaves about 14.7 seconds, close to H200's 14.4-second non-denoising overhead. The fitted B200 per-step time was 2.08x lower.

ladder_guardrails_off.note: Isolated single-service cells; the unused GPUs did no benchmark work. The sequential full-node topology cells are in b200-topology.json.

ladder_vs_published_grid.note: The NVIDIA figures come from NVIDIA/cosmos inference_benchmarks.md. The compared runs used different runtime and driver versions, so this record makes no causal attribution.

concurrency_guardrails_on.note: The client timeout was 5400 seconds. Reported peak memory was equal in these two cells, consistent with queueing.

determinism.note: B200 restart band is tighter than H200's 26.8-29.0 dB; do not port the H200 floor to B200

v0260_control.guardrails_on: initialization fails because the v0.26.0 image does not include the cosmos-guardrail package

guardrails_off.note: output differs from the pinned image at the same seed: median PSNR 30.54 dB, below the B200 restart band
